question: Which Arc took you the longest to write, in terms of things like planning the story?
answer:
As you all know, Arc 6! Re had been running for ten years, and I spent a whopping four of those years on it!

There were also various anime-related jobs coming in while I was writing Arc 6, and I still had plenty of lead time with the web version, so...

Even though it was an Arc that required readers to really think while reading, I regret leaving such long gaps between updates.

That said, I personally feel that the ending turned out considerably better than what I had originally envisioned.

In particular, I feel that I wrote Meili quite well. Originally, I hadn't planned on giving her nearly as much of a role.

Until around the end of Arc 6, I had thought of her as a “companion” rather than a member of the faction. Now that Arc 6 is over, though, I've settled on her as being in a position where I think you could reasonably call her “a member of Emilia's faction.”

Right now, while the Arc 7 bonus SSs are covering Emilia and the others going to the Empire to help Subaru, they're also showing what Meili is doing back in the Kingdom of Lugunica, including some interactions with Reinhard. So I hope you'll look forward to seeing what Meili does in the future.
